tasks.check:
set -e
[ -e .venv ] || ln -s /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv .venv
export PYTHONPATH=$PWD TMPDIR=/tmp
PY=.venv/bin/python
for f in $(git status --porcelain | grep -v '\.venv' | sed 's/^...//'); do
  case "$f" in
    data/stories/continuity-initiative/knowledge.yaml|data/stories/continuity-initiative/storylet-routes.yaml|tests/test_2c_ledger_guard.py) ;;
    *) echo "WHY: edited file outside ownership: $f"; exit 1;;
  esac
done
git diff --quiet HEAD -- storygame packages tests/test_canon_journey.py tests/test_delivery_variants.py tests/test_reveal_prerequisites.py || { echo "WHY: engine or protected tests edited"; exit 1; }
$PY - <<'EOF'
import subprocess, yaml
old = yaml.safe_load(subprocess.run(["git","show","HEAD:data/stories/continuity-initiative/knowledge.yaml"],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout)["knowledge"]
new = yaml.safe_load(open("data/stories/continuity-initiative/knowledge.yaml"))["knowledge"]
ob = {k["id"]: k for k in old}; nb = {k["id"]: k for k in new}
assert set(ob) == set(nb), "WHY: knowledge ids changed"
changed = [i for i in ob if ob[i] != nb[i]]
assert changed == ["k_sl_2b_b_r5"], f"WHY: only k_sl_2b_b_r5 may change, got {changed}"
gained = [e for e in nb["k_sl_2b_b_r5"]["establishes"] if e not in ob["k_sl_2b_b_r5"]["establishes"]]
assert len(gained) == 1 and gained[0].get("op") == "retract" and gained[0].get("fact_id") == "brandon_name_kept", f"WHY: expected exactly one retract of brandon_name_kept, got {gained}"
assert [e for e in ob["k_sl_2b_b_r5"]["establishes"] if e not in nb["k_sl_2b_b_r5"]["establishes"]] == [], "WHY: existing establishes removed"
ro = yaml.safe_load(subprocess.run(["git","show","HEAD:data/stories/continuity-initiative/storylet-routes.yaml"],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout)
rn = yaml.safe_load(open("data/stories/continuity-initiative/storylet-routes.yaml"))
def reals(d):
    return {r["id"]: r for s_ in d["storylets"] for r in s_["realization_options"]}
a, b = reals(ro), reals(rn)
assert set(a) == set(b), "WHY: realization ids changed"
assert [i for i in a if a[i] != b[i]] == ["SL-2B-B-R5"], "WHY: only SL-2B-B-R5 may change"
assert [o for o in b["SL-2B-B-R5"]["operations"] if o not in a["SL-2B-B-R5"]["operations"]] == [{"op": "retract", "fact_id": "brandon_name_kept"}], "WHY: SL-2B-B-R5 must gain exactly the same retract op"
assert {k: v for k, v in rn.items() if k != "storylets"} == {k: v for k, v in ro.items() if k != "storylets"}, "WHY: non-storylet content of routes changed"
print("data ok")
EOF
$PY -m pytest -q -n0 -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_canon_journey.py tests/test_2c_ledger_guard.py tests/test_2c_turn_one_copy.py tests/test_reveal_prerequisites.py tests/test_stall_exit_audit.py tests/test_evidence_gap_journeys.py tests/test_evidence_penalty.py tests/test_markdown_story_package.py tests/test_spine_expected_reveals.py tests/test_incident_engine.py tests/test_incident_loader.py tests/test_incident_recovery.py $(ls tests/test_2b_*.py tests/test_3a_*.py tests/test_3b_*.py 2>/dev/null) > /tmp/r4.log 2>&1 || { tail -40 /tmp/r4.log; echo "WHY: focused suites failed"; exit 1; }
tail -3 /tmp/r4.log
$PY -m ruff format --check . && $PY -m ruff check . || { echo "WHY: ruff"; exit 1; }
OUT=/home/bcorfman/dev/ringer-work/act2-2c-yes
mkdir -p $OUT && git add -A >/dev/null 2>&1 && git diff --cached > $OUT/s2.patch && wc -l $OUT/s2.patch && git diff --cached --stat | tail -5
